RuleDivChain: Latent (A2-84): the overflow test negates the divisor of an unsigned division as if it were signed; `(x >> 48) / 0xfffffffffffff800` becomes `x / 0xf800000000000000`. In situ it applies 80 times in family 59 and agrees
RuleDivOpt: WRONG, reached by SH-2 code: A2-82 (P2). No check that the multiply fits its width, and a sign-mismatched shift (`ext`/`>>` of the other sign) taken as a division whenever `8*size - n == xsize`, though the output's top n bits are read. Printed-C: family 60 27 of 1,500 `mismatch`, family 56 forms 6 and 7; in situ (wrapped samples skipped) 12 applications
RuleDivTermAdd: Not value-preserving a step at a time (the widened product on the way to RuleDivOpt), so the in-situ check does not look at the step; end to end every SH-2 family agrees (21, 22, 24, 56, 59, 60, both images) except through RuleDivOpt (A2-82). By value wrong only for a multiplier of 2^(8n) - 2 or the like, a sign-extended literal in a product wider than any SH-2 multiply builds (A2-87, latent)
